named_premises: Actual definite information requires an observer; without observation, information remains potential and indefinite.
soundness.denial_cost: The observer-specific actualization reading and its dependent collapse/terminal-observer claims lose their stated stance; this is not denial of observation or all quantum theory.

obstructions.reason: The derivation stops when the record moves from P-IMAGO's claim that creaturely consciousness and intelligibility reflect God to the claim that observation is necessary for potential information to become actual definite information; A0 + P-IMAGO supply no measurement or information-actualization rule.
